meta.title: Declining and then accepting: the latest answer wins in the vendor's event view
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: No setup recipe creates a live RFQ whose vendor has already declined at event level.
The event-level POST /user_intents request is not expressible because /user_intents is not an allowed request route and no operation covers it.
The vendor event view has no sampled read-back field for the saved acceptance, so the acceptance itself cannot be verified.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: As the invited QA vendor, read the event and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
